propositions: The enrich drain holds an advisory lock across NO-TIMEOUT LLM calls (437s, 131s observed), causing single-flight behavior where every spawned drain child exits with lock-held skip, creating a standing backlog of ~1,046 entries below enqueue rate.

Restructure drain() into three phases—COLLECT (under lock: concurrency guard, self-heal, pending scan, optimistic claims), ENRICH (no lock: LLM calls), FINALIZE (revalidate content hash, skip emit if stale, re-enqueue with soak 0, else emit digest + DONE)—to release the lock before LLM execution.
Raise DEFAULT_OVERLAP_DRAIN_BATCH from 5 to 20 and clamp the effective batch to lease_ttl_s // 40 (≈22 at 15-min default lease) so the batch never outrun its lease mid-run.

Bound concurrent drainers to 3 distinct live-lease drainer_ids with a concurrency guard that returns {"skipped": "concurrency-cap"} when the cap is exceeded, allowing normal per-write spawned drain children to become productive concurrent drainers.

Tickets edited between claim and finalize (stale-at-writeback) skip digest emit, are re-enqueued with soak 0, and are counted as stale_skipped; lease-expired claims are recovered by subsequent drains.
